# GOORGPIN fixes an org module's version for a whole CI run. Only CI may set
# it. The unit tests in orgpin_test.go cover the pinned path, because this
# test cannot prove it is outside a coding agent.

[short] skip 'constructs local git repositories'
[!git] skip

env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=$WORK${/}home${/}gopher${/}.gitconfig
env HOME=$WORK${/}home${/}gopher
env GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL=file
env GOPRIVATE=github.com/wow-look-at-my
[!GOOS:windows] exec git config --global 'url.file://'$WORK'/alpha.insteadOf' 'https://github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha'
[GOOS:windows]  exec git config --global 'url.file:///'$WORK'/alpha.insteadOf' 'https://github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha'

env GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='Go Gopher'
env GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='gopher@golang.org'
env GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME
env GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL

# This first commit matches the one in org_branch_head.txt, so its
# pseudo-version is known.
cd $WORK/alpha
exec git init
env GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2026-01-02T03:04:05Z
env GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2026-01-02T03:04:05Z
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'alpha main'
exec git branch -m main

cd $WORK/m
go list -m github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha
stdout '^github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha v0\.0\.0-20260102030405-0f69f837cebe$'

# The branch moves on after the run resolved it.
cd $WORK/alpha
cp $WORK${/}alpha-next${/}alpha.go alpha.go
env GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2026-01-03T04:05:06Z
env GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2026-01-03T04:05:06Z
exec git commit -am 'alpha next'

# Without a pin, the next command sees the new head.
cd $WORK/m
go run .
stdout '^alpha-next$'

# Only CI may pin. Outside CI a pin is an error, never a quiet no-op, so it
# cannot hold alpha at an old commit.
env GOORGPIN='github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha=v0.0.0-20260102030405-0f69f837cebe'
! go list -m github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha
stderr 'GOORGPIN: honored only in CI'
! go run .
stderr 'GOORGPIN: honored only in CI'

# A coding agent inside CI may not pin either.
env GITHUB_ACTIONS=true
env CLAUDECODE=1
! go list -m github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha
stderr 'GOORGPIN: refused under a coding agent'

# With no pin set, the command resolves the branch head as before.
env GOORGPIN=
env GITHUB_ACTIONS=
env CLAUDECODE=
go run .
stdout '^alpha-next$'

-- $WORK/home/gopher/.gitconfig --
[user]
	name = Go Gopher
	email = gopher@golang.org
-- $WORK/alpha/go.mod --
module github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha

go 1.21
-- $WORK/alpha/alpha.go --
package alpha

func Name() string { return "alpha-main" }
-- $WORK/alpha/sub/go.mod --
module github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha/sub

go 1.21
-- $WORK/alpha/sub/sub.go --
package sub

func Name() string { return "sub-main" }
-- $WORK/alpha-next/alpha.go --
package alpha

func Name() string { return "alpha-next" }
-- $WORK/m/go.mod --
module example.com/consumer

go 1.21

require github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha v0.0.0
-- $WORK/m/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(alpha.Name()) }
